EC1: Current inpatient [AND] hospitalization [OR] or active suicidal ideation [AND] requiring referral [AND] for inpatient hospitalization for safety.
EC2: History of psychotic disorder [OR] or manic episode [AND] diagnosed by MINI-KID
EC3: History of substance dependence [OR] diagnosis by MINI-KID ([NOT] excluding tobacco) or positive urine toxicology.
EC4: Pregnancy (urine pregnancy tests [AND] on the day of scans for menstruating girls).
EC5: [NOT] Inability to provide written informed consent according to the Yale Human Investigation Committee (HIC) guidelines in English.
